title: Flashcards from lecture decks
text: A web app that turns a student's lecture slides into flashcards. University students retype cards from slides by hand today and diagrams get lost on export.

title: Flaky test finder
text: A dashboard for developers that reruns CI pipelines, finds flaky tests and explains which test is flaky.

title: Offline gym log
text: A mobile app where gym users log sets offline and export their workout history to CSV.

title: SlideCards for my course
text: A web app that turns a student's own lecture slides into spaced-repetition flashcards, for university students.

title: SymptomBuddy
text: A chatbot that gives patients a diagnosis from their symptoms and suggests a medication dosage.
